admission.justification: Binds the v2 receipt verdict to two values: unmeasured never appears in a v2 receipt on any product path.

alternatives.option: FinalOutputReceipt carries bound/moved only; delivered_memory_content_commit and delivered_memory_tree_id are required; code_match/memory_match are measured against the reviewed input.
alternatives.reason: unmeasured belongs to the v1 generation record; writing it into v2 would claim a comparison that was never measured.

alternatives.option: Keep writing unmeasured into v2 receipts.
alternatives.reason: unmeasured belongs to the v1 generation record; a v2 unmeasured claims a comparison never measured.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A third verdict state is governed with its own measurement rule.

consequences: Receipt rendering keeps the two-valued verdict and the required delivery identities; legacy shapes stay in LegacyFinalOutputReceipt.
context: Ruling 814778 rebinding with receipt narrowing: the receipt is data about exact compared outputs, never leaf or Git acceptance.
